description: This file defines a React functional component named TrendMetricCard that displays a metric value with trend analysis, optional icon, subtitle, and sparkline visualization. It uses various UI components and utility functions for rendering the card with trend indicators and loading states.

methods.name: TrendMetricCard
methods.description: React component function that renders a metric card with trend indicator, icon, subtitle, and optional sparkline. It uses useMemo to optimize calculations of trend data and sparkline color. Accepts props for label, value, trend data, icon, and loading state.
